newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile's economy grows 8.1 pct in December.
newsitem.headline: Chile's economy grows 8.1 pct in December.

text.p: Chile's economy grew a strong 8.1 percent in December compared with the same month in 1995 as measured by the government's monthly Imacec index, said the Central Bank in its fortnightly report.
The index showed growth speeding up sharply from November when the economy expanded 5.8 percent.
December's growth was the highest level recorded since April 1996 when the economy grew eight percent.
The Imacec index is widely regarded as a rough measure of the growth of Chile's gross domestic product.
